segments.title: August
segments.text: Hello Kenkere House! August is The Amazing Race, version two. Friendship Day, Independence Day, and a studio-wide race that turns attendance into a sport. Half the city is on holiday. The other half is on our leaderboard.

segments.title: ₹11.01L
segments.text: So, the number. Our August target for Kenkere House is 11 lakh rupees. That's 15 per cent more than last August. Ambitious, yes. Unreasonable, no.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 5.84 lakh rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 3.74 lakh, everything else 77,100, and comebacks 66,100. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 55 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 817 leads, 294 trials, and 55 buyers, with about 19 per cent of trials converting. Every five trials should become about one member. Make those first classes unforgettable.
Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 7.22 lakh rupees, which is 66 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Friends With Benefits (Strictly Fitness)
segments.text: First up, Friends With Benefits. Strictly fitness. Bring a friend who's never been, and they get two classes on us. If they join, you both get race tees, and you get bonus days and double points. The plan is 4 buyers at about 12,400, so 49,600 rupees.

segments.title: Rookie Mistake (The Only Good One)
segments.text: Next, for newcomers, Rookie Mistake, the only good one. Two weeks unlimited at an intro price, plus a spot on the rookie leaderboard. The only rookie mistake is not starting. The plan is 9 buyers at about 11,700, so 1.05 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Medal Detector
segments.text: Then, for race finishers, the Medal Detector. Finish the race and your renewal finds gold. Six months at twenty per cent off plus a private, or three months at fifteen per cent off plus bonus days. The plan is 15 buyers at about 30,000, so 4.5 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: 6M ≈24% effective with private, inside the cap for 6M+ plans

segments.title: At the Stroke of the Midnight Hour
segments.text: And finally, on Independence Day, At the Stroke of the Midnight Hour. Annual memberships at twenty-five per cent off, for the fifteenth of August only, with a strictly limited count. When the world sleeps, our members renew. The plan is 1 buyer at about 1.17 lakh, so 1.17 lakh rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, Friendship Day, and every friend gets two classes on us. Week two, Independence Day, and the midnight annual sale for one day only. Week three, the rookie leaderboard heats up, so celebrate newcomers by name. Week four, race finishers get their Medal Detector renewal.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's August at Kenkere House. 11 lakh rupees, four offers, and 55 buyers to welcome. On your marks. Get set. Sell.
